properties.description:
BUILT 2026-10-30 on branch feat/the-fold-and-removal-candidates-ship-as-counted-stubs, for req:the-2026-10-30-fold-and-removal-candidates-ship-as-counted-refusing-stubs-then-december-decides (Anthony, "Yes, go with B"). REUSES the retirement registry (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/deprecation.rs REGISTRY): a new kind of entry, Deprecation::stub (stub_since 2026-10-30, deprecated_in 0.96.0), whose mark reads "RETIRED on 2026-10-30 (0.96.0): a refusing stub that changes nothing, and every call to it is counted; at the re-count (about 2026-12-23) it is deleted if nobody called it and restored if somebody did. <what to do>" and goes before the tool's own (unchanged) description at list time. Each stub's #[tool] handler is service::stub_answer: an invalid_params refusal opening "REFUSED:" (classed `refused` in the usage ledger, written under the stub's own name), naming what to do and, for a fold, the exact survivor call built from the caller's arguments. The old bodies stay as <tool>_kept, so a restore re-points the handler. usage_report gains `retired_stubs` (deprecation::stub_counts: each stub's count in the window, zeros included, called/not_called, re_count). find_tools never offers a stub but still weighs words over its description, so no other tool's score moves. Stubs are read-only; writers.json and settles.rs drop them; draw_edges refuses items naming verifies or gate_on with the stub's answer; the remote client stops measuring for set_artifact_checksum so the call reaches the server and is counted; the cue vocabulary leaves stubs out.
FOLDS, the survivor carrying the job: set_artifact_checksum -> set_artifact_checksums (one-item accepts); acknowledge_gap -> acknowledge_gaps (one-item gaps); dimension_drift -> dimension_drifts, which gains optional target_id and dimension (both: the old single-node reading, run through dimension_drift_kept; either alone narrows the sweep); propagate_change -> propagate_from, where ONE ChangeEvent seed now runs propagate_change_kept (walk from the CHANGED nodes, stale_edge_evidence, seeded_by_change) and a ChangeEvent among several seeds is walked as a node with change_seeds_walked_as_nodes saying so; verifies -> add_verification with id + verifies (a revise keeps every omitted field, tested); graph_report_markdown -> graph_report with a new `format` (json default unchanged, markdown = the old document via graph_report_markdown_kept). RETIRED, nothing replaces them: evidence_report, forecast_readiness, frontier, ility_report, granularity_report, consumption_report, surprising_connections, readiness_report, gate_on; the core computations are untouched (graph_report still reads granularity and surprises; derived relations still read evidence and readiness).
SERVED TEXT names survivors (skills + copies, get_instructions, VS Code route, connect-time instructions, cues, literals, schema prose, site hub/setup); no_served_text_names_a_tool_that_is_not_served treats a stub as unnamed. The first-read cue reads "graph_report with format markdown" and its id moves from instructions/graph_report_markdown to instructions/graph_report. Reworded, no rename: report_manual_work WRITES / manual_work_ledger READS, add_epoch past / plan_epoch future, scan_nodes by TYPE / search_design by what nodes SAY. Served tools stay 199.
properties.name: The fifteen 2026-10-30 candidates are counted refusing stubs — listed, changing nothing, answering with the call that does their job, counted under their own names — and each fold's survivor carries the job
